quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026: revenue RMB 429.39 million, +63.34% year on year; net profit attributable RMB 50.08 million, +36.88% (RMB 71.54 million, +95.53%, excluding share-based payment). Optical-communications revenue RMB 261.55 million, +104.12%; fibre-laser revenue -4.39%; semiconductor-equipment and biomedical revenue +91.18%. Gross margin 39.48%, up 1.98 percentage points. Growth was driven by accelerated delivery of passive components for data-center high-speed optical modules and of YVO4 crystals for OCS.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 429.39 million (+63.34%); net profit RMB 50.08 million (+36.88%); optical communications revenue +104.12%; gross margin 39.48%

quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and products: filters and aspheric lenses for 800G/1.6T optical modules are ramping in capacity and deliveries; passive components are being applied in liquid-crystal, MEMS and piezo-ceramic OCS switches; Phase I and Phase II expansions for large-size pure YVO4 crystal (used in OCS) at the Hefei base were completed and capacity is being released; the 2D collimator array won an important customer order and is in small-batch production. The Thailand base is built and in pre-production trial runs; Zhengzhou adds high-speed passive capacity and Wuhan develops EML / silicon-photonics COB light engines for pluggable modules.

quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H2 2026 plan (company): accelerate expansion projects, strengthen delivery of precision optical components for multiple optical-interconnect forms and of semiconductor-equipment optical modules, and keep driving OCS passive-component order intake and batch delivery.
